$comment: Bank of Israel mortgage limits (Proper Conduct of Banking Business Directive 329, version 13, circular 2852, 30/06/2026) used by the affordability calculator.

maxPaymentToIncome.note: s. 5. Hard cap. Banks usually approve well below it; above 40% the loan carries a higher capital charge (s. 6).

recommendedPaymentToIncome.note: Our conservative default for the affordability result; not a regulatory figure.

maxVariableRateShare.note: s. 7. The variable-rate part of a housing loan (incl. a non-purchase loan secured by a home) may not exceed 66.66% (two-thirds) of the loan.

maxLtv.note: s. 10a. A bank MAY choose not to apply the usual combined-LTV cap (s. 4, based on the home's category under s. 2) to a housing loan not taken to purchase a property right — up to this LTV — subject to excessOverHalfCapIls below. This is a bank discretion, not a borrower entitlement.

excessOverHalfCapIls.note: s. 10a. The part of the loan that brings LTV above 50% may not exceed this amount.

anyPurposeSmallLoanExemptionIls.note: s. 12.2. A loan for any purpose up to this amount, secured by a home, is exempt from the maxVariableRateShare limit (s. 7).
